title: Kali Middleby
text: I’m a postdoctoral researcher studying tropical tree ecophysiology — how leaves manage heat and drought stress, and what that means for canopy energy balance and forest carbon and water cycling under climate change. My work combines field physiology with process-based vegetation modelling (TROLL, PlantSimEngine, PlantBiophysics).
